crossRefs.note: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as…
who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they…
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
Therefore comfort one another with these words.
Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in…
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says…
for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

translations.web: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
translations.bsb: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
translations.kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
translations.asv: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called To-day; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin:
